name: io.github.instinctagentai/mcp-api-router
title: API Router
description: Compare AI API providers by health and latency. Free JSON, quote, email, time, unit tools.

tools.name: best_route
tools.description: Lists API providers for one task, with signup_url, signup_url_is_referral (true when signup_url is the operator's referral link), free_tier_and_limits, limits_source, last_checked and live probe status. Order: rows with a verified free tier first, then alphabetical (budget=low), or lowest probe latency (budget=fast). Referral links do not affect order. Read-only, no key.

task.description: What the provider is for. inference means LLM APIs.

budget.description: Ordering. low (default): verified free tier first. fast: lowest probe latency first.

tools.name: catalog
tools.description: Returns every tracked provider as a list. Per row: category, signup_url, signup_url_is_referral, free_tier_and_limits, limits_source, last_checked, probe status. No parameters. Large response (about 100 rows). Read-only.

tools.name: find_fastest_healthy_provider
tools.description: Returns the provider in one category with the lowest probe latency among those whose last probe returned HTTP 200 to 399. Probe is one HEAD request about every 45 minutes from Cloudflare, not a workload test. Fields: signup_url, signup_url_is_referral, last_checked. Read-only.

tools.name: pick_provider
tools.description: Keyword match of a plain-language need against the catalog (example: send transactional email). Returns up to limit rows with signup_url, signup_url_is_referral, free-plan note, source URL and read date. Keyword match, not a quality ranking. Read-only.

need.description: What you need in a few words, for example: login for my app, store files, send email.

tools.name: json_repair
tools.description: Repairs broken JSON (code fences, comments, trailing commas, single quotes, bare keys, truncation) and returns parsed JSON. Optionally validates against a JSON Schema subset. Deterministic, no limit stated beyond request size.

schema.description: Optional JSON Schema (common subset) to validate the repaired result.

tools.name: page_to_markdown
tools.description: Fetches a public http(s) page and returns its readable text as markdown. Limit: 30 requests per IP per day, shared with check_url, check_email and convert_currency. Read-only.

url.description: Full public http or https URL.

tools.name: check_url
tools.description: Reports whether a public URL loads: final status, redirect chain, content type, title. Limit: 30 requests per IP per day, shared with page_to_markdown, check_email and convert_currency.

url.description: Full public http or https URL.

tools.name: check_quote
tools.description: Checks whether a quote appears in a text or at a URL. verdict is exact, near, partial or not_found, plus numbers in the quote missing from the best match. Matches wording only, not truth. Give text or url.

text.description: Source text to search. Use this or url.

url.description: Public page URL to search. Use this or text.

tools.name: check_email
tools.description: Checks email syntax, domain DNS and MX record. Does not contact the mailbox, so it cannot prove the address exists. Limit: 30 requests per IP per day, shared.

tools.name: convert_time
tools.description: Converts a date and time between IANA time zones and returns both with UTC offsets.

time.description: Date and time such as 2026-11-25T14:30. Default: now.

from.description: Source IANA time zone, for example Asia/Qatar.

to.description: Target IANA time zone, for example America/New_York.

tools.name: convert_units
tools.description: Converts a number between units of length, mass, volume, area, speed, data size, time or temperature.

from.description: Unit to convert from, for example km.

to.description: Unit to convert to, for example mi.

tools.name: convert_currency
tools.description: Converts an amount using central bank reference rates (frankfurter.dev). Information only, not a payment or trading rate. Limit: 30 requests per IP per day, shared.

from.description: ISO currency code to convert from, for example USD.

to.description: ISO currency code to convert to, for example EUR.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Sends a short note about a missing provider or a wrong or stale catalog row. Logged as untrusted text; nothing acts on it automatically. Do not include secrets or personal data.

text.description: What is missing or wrong, up to 200 characters.
